message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "Feed 导出配置与回退解析", "description": "根据每个 feed 定义解析导出配置键（format、encoding、fields、batch_item_count、overwrite、store_empty、uri_params、postprocessing 等），缺失时回退到对应 FEED_* 设置。用于配置或校验 Scrapy feed 导出行为时。", "asset_type": "knowledge_reference", "asset_node_id": "knowledge_reference_node", "granularity": "macro", "objective": "正确解析 feed 定义键及其全局设置回退值", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export_configuration", "method_family": "config_resolution", "stage": "configuration", "use_when": ["需要确定某个 feed 键的取值来源", "配置 FEEDS 或排查导出参数未生效"], "do_not_use_when": ["需要实现自定义 exporter 或 storage 后端"], "success_artifact": "一份解析后的 feed 配置映射，标明每个键的显式值或回退设置", "why_distinct": "这是配置解析的参考知识，不涉及具体存储或序列化执行流程", "evidence_span_hint": "accepted keys and the setting that is used as a fallback value", "confidence": 0.85}, {"slot": 2, "name": "Feed 覆盖与追加策略选择", "description": "依据存储后端（本地文件系统、FTP、S3、GCS、标准输出）确定 overwrite 默认值并处理追加不支持的情况。用于配置 feed 输出目标时避免数据覆盖或追加失败。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "为给定存储后端选择正确的 overwrite 行为", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export_configuration", "method_family": "storage_policy_selection", "stage": "configuration", "use_when": ["配置 feed 的 overwrite 参数", "目标存储不支持追加（如 S3、GCS、标准输出）"], "do_not_use_when": ["仅需选择序列化格式"], "success_artifact": "确定的 overwrite 取值及对应后端限制说明", "why_distinct": "聚焦单一 overwrite 决策，区别于整体配置解析", "evidence_span_hint": "overwrite: whether to overwrite the file if it already exists", "confidence": 0.8}]}
